We need to get the list of all airports. Then compute flight cost from first to last. Then we need to get the credit card balance? Actually they want estimated total payable amount. We might need to get the credit card balance to see if enough funds. But the user didn't ask for that. They just want estimated total payable amount. So we need to compute flight cost. Then maybe add insurance? Not asked. So just flight cost.

We need to call get_flight_cost with travel_from=first airport code, travel_to=last airport code, travel_date=2024-10-31, travel_class=business.

But we need to get the list of airports first. So call list_all_airports. Then compute flight cost. Then provide estimated total payable amount.

We don't need to authenticate or anything else. So let's do that.
